description.p: OpenVysor shows an Android phone on your computer and lets you control it with the mouse and keyboard. Open the whole phone, or give every app its own phone-shaped window.
Video and input travel only between your phone and your computer, over USB or your own Wi-Fi. There is no account and no server, and the phone needs no root.

ul.li: Each app runs on its own virtual display, so several can sit side by side
Clipboard in both directions, screenshots and MP4 recording
Wi-Fi by QR code, pairing code, IP address, or one click from USB
A file browser, and drag and drop to install APKs or send files

description.p: The phone needs USB debugging turned on. OpenVysor uses Android's adb tool, which it can download from Google with one click.
